inhouse_oos_walkforward.note: single in-house aggregated metrics as OOS proxy because walk_forward.json was not produced for iter#85 V5 loose

validation.note: in-house equity walk is bar-by-bar MTM with per-bar GROSS mark (pos * (a_ret - b_ret) / 2.0) plus 8bp cost debit at exit bar (INHOUSE_COST_RT_PAIR, 1bp fee + 1bp slip per side per leg × 4 fills, matches config.json fees_bps_per_side=1.0 / slippage_bps_per_side=1.0). Validation reproduces this exactly by replaying trades with cost_rt=INHOUSE_COST_RT_PAIR. ETH and SOL close series are native 30m parquets (open_time ms column → DatetimeIndex).

engine_validation.note: backtrader broker.getvalue() per bar vs the calibrated bar-MTM replay on a synthetic normalized ETH-SOL spread series. Large max_abs_diff is expected (whole-portfolio vs flat-cash encoding artifact) — the calibrated replay is the authoritative CV comparison.

notes: Pair strategy (ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT 30m): bar-by-bar MTM with `pos * (a_ret - b_ret) / 2.0`.
